'''2003 Minnesota State Championship Shane Engelking LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Shane Engelking]] at [[2003 Minnesota State Championship]], finishing 2nd; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by shane "elvis solo" engelking (2004-03-07).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=31713 A bunch of Simple Tricks and Nonsense]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050923181018/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=31713 Internet Archive]</ref>
